title: FineVerify: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Fine-Grained Self-Verification for Agentic Search
authors_zh: James Xu Zhao、Hui Chen、Bryan Hooi、See-Kiong Ng（新加坡国立大学）
paper_type_zh: 面向智能体搜索的细粒度测试时验证研究
best_for_zh: 设计多证据问答、网页搜索智能体与轨迹选择器的读者。
one_line: FineVerify turns each sampled agent trajectory into sub-question-level checks, enabling a more reliable selection policy as the test-time trajectory budget grows.
FineVerify 将每条搜索轨迹按可检查的子问题逐项验证，再用聚合得分选择答案，从而提升轨迹扩展的有效性。
why: It shows that adding trajectories is useful only when the selector can inspect their multi-claim evidence rather than rely on a single confidence score.
inclusion_reason: It makes verifier granularity and candidate selection the mechanism through which additional agent trajectories improve at inference time.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Sampling more agent trajectories can improve web search and evidence gathering, but correct answers are sparse and a long trajectory can look convincing while missing one decisive condition. Majority voting is weak when the right answer occurs rarely, while a single overall confidence score is unreliable when the answer depends on several independently checkable claims.

The paper asks how extra test-time trajectories can be selected without collapsing verification into one opaque score. It targets information-seeking questions that must be decomposed into factual sub-questions, so the central resource-allocation question is not only how many trajectories to sample but how to inspect them under a shared, explicit checking contract.

增加智能体搜索轨迹能够改善网页检索和证据收集，但正确答案通常稀少，一条长轨迹也可能看起来很有说服力，却漏掉某个决定性条件。当正确答案很少出现时，多数投票很弱；而当答案依赖多个可独立核验的主张时，单一总体置信度分数同样不可靠。

本文研究如何选择额外的测试时轨迹，而不把验证压缩成一个不透明的分数。它面向必须拆分成事实子问题的信息检索问题，因此核心的资源分配问题不仅是采样多少轨迹，还包括如何在共同、明确的检查契约下审查这些轨迹。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
FineVerify changes candidate selection from a global self-score into a collection of local checks. It first decomposes a question into sub-questions that a correct response must satisfy. Each sampled search trajectory is then verified against each sub-question, and the final score aggregates those aligned judgments rather than trusting answer frequency or a free-form assertion of confidence.

This makes the verification trace itself part of the inference record: a candidate contains its search path, the decomposed requirements, the per-requirement checks, and the aggregate used for ranking. More test-time samples become valuable when at least one trajectory covers the required facts, while the fine-grained score gives the selector a way to identify that coverage.

FineVerify 将候选选择从全局自评分改为一组局部检查。它先把问题拆分成正确回答必须满足的子问题，再逐个子问题验证每条采样搜索轨迹；最终分数聚合这些对齐判断，而不是相信答案频率或自由形式的自信表述。

这使验证轨迹本身成为推理记录的一部分：一个候选包含其搜索路径、拆分出的要求、逐项检查以及用于排序的聚合分数。当至少有一条轨迹覆盖所需事实时，更多测试时样本才有价值；细粒度分数则让选择器能识别这种覆盖。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a user question, the system constructs checkable sub-questions and samples complete agentic-search trajectories. It evaluates each candidate against every sub-question under the same criteria, records the resulting judgments, aggregates them, and returns the candidate with the highest aggregate. This is an inference-time reranking procedure; it does not require training a new reward model in the reported workflow.

The experiments use GPT-5-mini and Gemini-3-flash across four agentic-search benchmarks. FineVerify is compared with majority voting, weighted voting, Best-of-N, solution aggregation, and confidence verification as the number of sampled trajectories grows. The paper releases code and data, so a replication can inspect the decomposition prompts, verification prompts, aggregation rule, and benchmark-specific answer extraction rather than treating the final leaderboard score as the whole method.

对于一个用户问题，系统先构造可检查的子问题，再采样完整的智能体搜索轨迹。它依据相同标准，让每个候选逐一接受每个子问题的验证，记录判断、聚合结果，并返回聚合分数最高的候选。这是测试时重排序流程；在论文报告的工作流中，它不需要训练新的奖励模型。

实验使用 GPT-5-mini 和 Gemini-3-flash，覆盖四个智能体搜索基准。随着采样轨迹数增加，FineVerify 与多数投票、加权投票、Best-of-N、解答聚合和置信度验证比较。论文发布了代码和数据，因此复现应检查拆分提示、验证提示、聚合规则和基准特定的答案提取，而不应把最终榜单分数当作方法的全部。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across four benchmarks and two models, the paper reports consistent gains over its scaling baselines. With four sampled trajectories, FineVerify improves GPT-5-mini by 8.2 accuracy points and Gemini-3-flash by 5.6 percentage points on average. Those comparisons directly test the claim that a fine-grained selector can make a small trajectory budget more useful than simple aggregation.

The strongest illustrated result is on BrowseComp-Plus: with twelve sampled trajectories, FineVerify lets GPT-5-mini exceed the reported GPT-5 reference score. The evidence is compelling for the stated benchmark and model APIs, but it is not a controlled statement about all web agents: retrieval conditions, decomposition quality, and model-judged verification can change together, so the released traces should be inspected when transferring the claim.

论文在四个基准和两个模型上报告了相对扩展基线的一致提升。使用四条采样轨迹时，FineVerify 使 GPT-5-mini 提升 8.2 个准确率点，使 Gemini-3-flash 平均提升 5.6 个百分点。这些比较直接检验了细粒度选择器能否让小规模轨迹预算比简单聚合更有价值。

最强的图示结果在 BrowseComp-Plus：使用十二条采样轨迹时，FineVerify 让 GPT-5-mini 超过论文报告的 GPT-5 参考分数。证据对所述基准和模型接口具有说服力，但并不等于所有网页智能体都如此：检索条件、拆分质量和模型判断验证可能同时改变，迁移主张时应检查发布的轨迹。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing test-time scaling methods often generate more paths and apply frequency voting, a global reward, or a single confidence estimate. FineVerify changes the verifier surface from one answer-level judgment to a matrix of candidate-by-sub-question checks. The same decomposition is used across candidates, making the score comparable and leaving an audit trail for why one trajectory outranked another.

The novel component is not web browsing by itself, nor simply self-verification. It is the use of an explicit fine-grained verification record as the consumer of a growing trajectory pool. Before reuse, readers should test whether the sub-questions are complete, whether they can be answered from retrieved evidence rather than model priors, and whether aggregation rewards superficial coverage over logically sufficient evidence.

既有测试时扩展方法常生成更多路径，再使用频率投票、全局奖励或单一置信度估计。FineVerify 把验证面从一次答案级判断改为“候选 × 子问题”的检查矩阵。同一拆分在各候选间共享，使分数可比较，也留下某条轨迹为何排名更高的审计痕迹。

新意不在网页浏览本身，也不只是自我验证，而在于让显式的细粒度验证记录消费不断增长的轨迹池。复用前，读者应测试子问题是否完整、是否能由检索证据而非模型先验回答，以及聚合是否奖励表面覆盖而非逻辑上充分的证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: FineVerify inherits the model's ability to decompose the question and to judge each sub-question, so a missing requirement or correlated self-verification error can still select a polished but wrong trajectory. Its cost includes more than trajectory count: decomposition and per-candidate, per-sub-question verification can become expensive on long multi-claim questions. Benchmark gains may also depend on retrieval access and answer extraction, and the paper's released artifacts should be checked for the exact prompts, search environment, and evaluation terms before production reuse.
FineVerify 继承了模型拆分问题和判断每个子问题的能力，因此漏掉某项要求或相关的自我验证错误，仍可能选出流畅却错误的轨迹。其成本不止是轨迹数量：在长、多主张问题上，拆分以及“每个候选 × 每个子问题”的验证都可能很昂贵。基准收益也可能依赖检索权限和答案提取；生产复用前应核对发布工件中的确切提示、搜索环境和评测条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a search agent must answer questions containing several factual conditions and a simple vote over trajectories is not credible. The operational template is to log a shared decomposition, retain candidate-level verification traces, measure accuracy at equal trajectory budgets, and separately account for verifier calls. The released repository is the right starting point for audit and reproduction, but a deployment should add held-out checks for decomposition completeness and evidence grounding before allowing the aggregate score to decide a high-stakes answer.
当搜索智能体必须回答包含多个事实条件的问题，而对轨迹做简单投票并不可信时，可使用本文。可操作的模板是记录共享拆分、保留候选级验证轨迹、在相同轨迹预算下衡量准确率，并单独统计验证器调用。发布仓库是审计与复现的正确起点，但部署前应为拆分完整性和证据落地添加留出检查，再让聚合分数决定高风险答案。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember that FineVerify scales a trajectory pool but changes the selector, not the generator. The key record is the question decomposition plus the per-trajectory, per-sub-question judgment matrix. Four trajectories already yield the paper's clearest average gain, whereas twelve trajectories are highlighted for BrowseComp-Plus. The headline should be read as evidence for fine-grained verification under these search settings, not as proof that self-judged web evidence is universally trustworthy.
应记住，FineVerify 扩展的是轨迹池，但改变的是选择器而非生成器。关键记录是问题拆分，以及“每条轨迹 × 每个子问题”的判断矩阵。四条轨迹已带来论文最清晰的平均收益，十二条轨迹则用于突出 BrowseComp-Plus 结果。标题结论应理解为这些搜索设置下细粒度验证的证据，而不是自我判断的网页证据在任何场景都可信的证明。
